bio: Black walls, gold touches, and slats along the ceiling make for a moody vibe at this stylish Indian restaurant. Tables stretch from the bright bar up front to the darker corners further back. The cooking is contemporary in nature, ranging from mushroom and kataifi phyllo bites to fish fry Amritsari to the classic chicken tikka masala. Lunch specials include naan rolled with the likes of paneer, ground lamb, and shrimp. An upbeat playlist keeps the room in good spirits....
